title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass | Polished Brass | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar that keeps towels within reach while saving space in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures.

  • Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
  • Hardware included: mounting plates and all installation hardware
  • Coordinating look: part of the Carolina Collection for versatile bath accessories

Specs

  • Collection: Carolina Collection
  • Style: Traditional
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.75 in
  • Overall dimensions: 30 in L × 2 in W × 3.5 in H
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included items: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
